purpose: Compare recorded recurring subscriptions and one-time features against measured usage, benchmark-derived value, and confidence-qualified ROI; maintain the selected vehicle's local subscription register.
primaryGoal: Understand subscription commitment, realised value, break-even usage, and candidate savings without treating an uncertain verdict as an instruction or transacting with a provider.

dataSources.behavior: Positive selected vehicle required; default page window is 180 days, options 30/90/180/365. Vehicle and window participate in the query key. Shared wrapper forwards AbortSignal and inherits query policy.
dataSources.sourceOwnership: Ownership intelligence service supplies the report; page derives chart rows only, filters null ROI, and formats money/percentages at presentation.

dataSources.behavior: Independent selected-vehicle register query; items null normalizes to an empty array. No analysis-window parameter.
Records local ownership data only; sends snake_case draft with current vehicle_id; invalidates ownership-intel queries and emits existing mutation toast. Success closes editor. Not invoked.
Local record removal after named danger confirmation; ownership-intel invalidation and existing toast. No provider cancellation. Not invoked.

dataSources.endpoint: Indirect shared useVehicles dependency; vehicles endpoint was not independently audited.
dataSources.owner: Existing workspace vehicle store and URL selection
dataSources.behavior: URL/store/fleet fallback; no duplicate page vehicle picker. Workspace route source resolves vehicle=true and range=false for this route.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Benchmark formatting repeats identical rounding and currency formatting in filterValueLabel and renderer.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse one feature-local display helper if this table is refactored; preserve rounding and canonical filter values.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local VERDICT_FILL parallels VerdictBadge's existing keep/review/cancel/too_early/unknown severity mapping with literal rgba colors.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consume existing restrained semantic/chart tokens without creating a new status registry or changing verdict meaning.

observations: Form reflows from one column to md two and xl three at page:583.
Chart uses ResponsiveContainer with fixed 280px height at page:506; many or long subscription names require actual narrow-width review.
EvidencePanel:58 reflows to three columns at lg.
DataTable:715-725 implements mobileColumns as hidden md:table-cell, not automatic full-detail cards.

issues.detail: Verdict mobile allow-list includes only name/verdict/roi; cost, spend/active days, usage, realised value, net, break-even/utilisation and reasoning are hidden below md. No mobilePresentation or expanded-detail contract is supplied.
issues.fix: Use the existing DataTable mobilePresentation/detail capability to keep every source field reachable, without adding a replacement table or dropping desktop columns.

issues.detail: Register mobile allow-list omits metric, benchmark and actions; shared hidden-column CSS removes the row Remove action below md. Caller supplies no alternate mobile action/detail path.
issues.fix: Retain confirm-gated Remove plus all register detail through existing mobile table adapter or an explicit reachable detail presentation.

accessibility.status: source-inspected; keyboard, focus, screen reader, contrast and touch-target behavior unverified
observations: Analysis-window Select has a translated aria-label at page:424.
Shared form controls have translated visible labels; money requiredness and name/currency length constraints are supplied.
ChartContainer supplies descriptive ariaLabel and all three dataColumns at page:492-505.
Verdicts have text badges, not color alone; destructive confirmation names the record and explicitly warns about history loss at page:129-140.
Icons supplied by the page are aria-hidden; no raw button/input/select/table source matches in the root page.

issues.detail: The Add subscription/Cancel toggle reveals an editor but supplies neither aria-expanded nor aria-controls; the revealed form has no linked stable region identity.
issues.fix: Add expansion semantics and a stable editor-region identity; preserve existing shared Button and keyboard behavior.

states.loading: OwnershipPanel:39-47 derives per-source initial loading; preserveSummary retains real summary skeleton pipeline. Register editing can proceed without a successful first read.
states.empty: Chart/verdict/register each have specific translated empty messages; null collections normalize to []. Summary preserves unknown metrics; EvidencePanel explains missing quality/evidence.
states.error: OwnershipPanel uses fatalError with retry; report and register remain separately sourced. Create/delete errors use MutationError. Existing page tests describe source isolation but were not executed.
states.retained: OwnershipPanel:46 maps stale to retained; OwnershipBrief:38-46 reports retained/refreshing source; shared deriveDataState preserves payload on refresh failure or pause.
states.offline: Shared deriveDataState:165-169 models paused retained sources as stale; distinct offline presentation and actual recovery were not exercised.
states.unknownVersusZero: Null ROI is excluded from bars and displays em dash; null monetary values go through formatCurrencyMinor's unavailable guard. Numeric zero remains a measured value. OwnershipBrief neutralizes tones for non-value metrics.
states.selection: Queries require a positive selected vehicle. Summary identifies selection-required through OwnershipBrief; register save disables when vehicleId is null.

issues.detail: Draft/form state is not keyed to selected vehicle. Submit at page:160-166 combines the retained draft with whichever vehicleId is current; changing the header vehicle while the editor remains open can associate a draft with another vehicle without an explicit draft-scope cue.
issues.fix: Bind the editor to an explicit source vehicle or surface a deliberate scoped confirmation/recovery when selection changes. Do not silently discard the draft or add a second vehicle picker.

visualIssues.detail: Verdict fills are local rgba literals rather than existing semantic/chart tokens; rendering does not follow saved palette/theme contracts through those literals.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing muted semantic chart colors, retain every verdict, and verify effective contrast in both themes.

visualIssues.detail: Net/ROI use fixed emerald-300/rose-300 classes (also page:267) and ROI zero is styled as negative; chart header uses decorative cyan at page:488. These are not neon, but fixed theme-independent financial colors require restrained semantic ownership and actual contrast review.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing semantic tokens; preserve signed values and distinguish zero from negative. Keep decorative icon low emphasis.

visualIssues.detail: Evidence source boxes use fixed border-white/background-white opacity decoration, while unsupported content at line 190 uses local amber surface classes.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing neutral surface/border and warning tokens in this shared ownership component; preserve all explanatory content and subregions.

visualIssues.detail: Confidence metadata uses raw text-xs styling; MoneyInput:47 similarly uses an ad-hoc text-xs suffix rather than the existing caption role.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing Text/Caption typography contracts while retaining tabular alignment and currency suffix.

architectureIssues.detail: Usage metric options are generated from English snake_case enum identifiers; register cell/filter labels at page:347-352 do the same. VerdictBadge:68 falls back to untranslated enum text; EvidencePanel:73 displays raw quality.status.
architectureIssues.fix: Map known codes to canonical localized domain labels at existing ownership owners, preserving raw wire/filter keys. Pass a translated label to VerdictBadge where supported; do not add a second catalog.

architectureIssues.detail: Page-owned windowDays and context Select bypass useRangeState. workspaceScope.ts:23-78 excludes this dated route, and useSubscriptionROI accepts only vehicle_id/window_days. Handler:991-998 parses only a day window, so simply adding a shell picker would not make custom bounds effective.
architectureIssues.fix: Treat range integration as coordinated shared/API work: preserve existing 30/90/180/365 behavior and register route only when typed hooks/server can honor both actual bounds, rolling/custom/timezone semantics. Do not invent endpoint support or filter only loaded rows.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-045 SI display boundary and explicit benchmark units
architectureIssues.detail: Usage and break-even show generic quantity plus server usage_unit unchanged (also page:283-288); benchmark form at page:660 names only 'minor / unit'. Page has no metric-aware physical conversion or visible canonical unit in the benchmark field. Backend metric-to-unit mappings were not inspected, so no numeric unit corruption is asserted.
architectureIssues.fix: Confirm actual source metric units before adoption; for physical metrics use existing useUnits display conversion and explicit canonical benchmark input hints while keeping raw SI/money/cache values unchanged. Counts and time must retain their distinct semantics.

priority.rationale: First preserve mobile detail/removal and workspace range/draft scope. Then localize domain labels and replace local fixed palette/surfaces without changing calculations or trust.
ordering: domain localization and SI unit clarity

competingImplementations.resolution: Coordinate actual bound support before adopting shared range.

competingImplementations.detail: Local verdict chart palette duplicates severity ownership; no new table, overlay, query client, surface library or formatter engine is proposed.
competingImplementations.resolution: Reuse current semantic palette and status vocabulary.
